svg.aria-label: TOHEŞAR Sticker 001 independent unapproved cutline location reference, do not print magenta line
svg.title: TOHEŞAR / STICKER 001 / R06 / CUTLINE LOCATION ONLY / NOT PRINT ART
svg.desc: Independent geometry reference: 100x30mm rectangle at x5 y5 on a 110x40mm artwork datum. RGB magenta on screen is NOT a certified CMYK M100 spot color or supplier-accepted PDF kiss-cut layer. No logo or print artwork embedded. Never print this as visible art; do not submit to printer without approved PDF layer separation, production-site selection and owner permission.
